reasons.claim: The first isnad runs from Abd Allah b. Muhammad to Ubayd Allah b. Adi and stops at the encounter with Uthman, written in short.
reasons.quote: أخبره دخلت، على عثمان

reasons.claim: Uthman speaks inside the narrated encounter, so under ruling 9 he is the last link of both routes.
reasons.quote: فتشهد ثم قال أما بعد

reasons.claim: The compiler's «وقال بشر» opens a second isnad that carries the full saying, so it is its own route headed by Bishr.
reasons.quote: وقال بشر بن شعيب حدثني أبي، عن الزهري

reasons.claim: The closing mutabaa is a remark about another version under ruling 6, and both readers keep it as a variant group.
reasons.quote: تابعه إسحاق الكلبي حدثني الزهري مثله

variant_verdicts.quote: تابعه إسحاق الكلبي حدثني الزهري مثله
تابعه إسحاق الكلبي حدثني الزهري مثله

reasons.claim: Two branches joined by «ح» meet at «قالا حدثنا شعبة», so Shuba to Abd Allah b. Mughaffal is shared by both routes.
reasons.quote: ح وحدثنا محمد بن الوليد، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، قالا حدثنا شعبة

reasons.claim: The shared tail continues through Abu al-Tayyah and Mutarrif to the Companion.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت مطرفا، عن عبد الله بن مغفل

reasons.claim: Bundar's closing words gloss a word of the matn and add no link.
reasons.quote: قال بندار العين حيطان المدينة

reasons.claim: The stored chain cut the first branch off after its second name, which the readers' routes repair.
reasons.quote: عثمان بن عمر

reasons.claim: A relation followed by a name is one link written as the name, so the brother and the father here are two links.
reasons.quote: عن أخيه علي، عن أبيه سيف بن عميرة

reasons.claim: Ali is named after «عن» and the saying that follows is his, so he is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي الطفيل، عن علي عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: The chain opens with the compiler's father, written only as a relation.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه

reasons.claim: The uncle is named after the comma, so «عمه، إسحاق بن طلحة» is one link before Aisha.
reasons.quote: عن عمه، إسحاق بن طلحة عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The Prophet speaks in the report Aisha relays, so the chain ends with Aisha as its last link.
reasons.quote: دخل على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال

reasons.claim: The closing sentence reports how some others transmitted it and is a remark about another version, not a route.
reasons.quote: وروى بعضهم هذا الحديث عن معن وقال عن موسى بن طلحة عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The grading remark adds no link.
reasons.quote: هذا حديث غريب

variant_verdicts.quote: وروى بعضهم هذا الحديث عن معن وقال عن موسى بن طلحة عن عائشة
وروى بعضهم هذا الحديث عن معن وقال عن موسى بن طلحة عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Yahya read to Malik, so Malik is a link, followed by Nafi and Ibn Umar.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: The definition of shighar after the saying explains a term and adds no link.
reasons.quote: والشغار أن يزوج الرجل ابنته

reasons.claim: The stored chain held only the first name, which the readers' route completes.
reasons.quote: يحيى بن يحيى

reasons.claim: The first isnad reaches Muhammad b. Urama and the second opens immediately with «و حدثني أبي», so the first does not end there but meets the second at the same name.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أُورَمَةَ وَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

reasons.claim: The tail after Muhammad b. Urama is written once and is shared by both opening isnads, ending at the Imam named as alternatives; the readers left the first route ending at Muhammad b. Urama, who relays no saying of his own.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أُورَمَةَ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ (ع) أَوْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثِ (ع) قَالَ

reasons.claim: The isnad after the saying is the compiler's own transmission of the same words, a route ending at Abu al-Hasan the Third, as both readers read it.
reasons.quote: عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثِ مِثْلَهُ

notes: The second isnad «و حدثني أبي» meets the first at محمد بن أورمة; the tail «عمن حدثه عن الصادق أو أبي الحسن الثالث» is written once and belongs to both, so it is written out in each group and shared_tail is null because the third route after the saying has its own tail.

reviews.uncertainty_note: No explicit joining word such as «ح» or «جميعا» marks the meeting point, so the shared tail rests on the second isnad repeating the same name before the tail is written.

reasons.claim: Amr b. Murra told them the report, so he is a link between Shuba and Khaythama, which the stored chain dropped.
reasons.quote: أن عمرو بن مرة، حدثهم عن خيثمة، عن عدي بن حاتم

reasons.claim: The words about Shuba describe how often the act was done and add no link.
reasons.quote: ذكر شعبة أنه فعله ثلاث مرات

reasons.claim: Seven branches meet at «كل هؤلاء» and share the tail Ibrahim b. Abd Allah b. Hunayn, his father, Ali.
reasons.quote: كل هؤلاء عن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين، عن أبيه، عن علي

reasons.claim: The dash remark inside the isnad states that the routes of al-Dahhak and Ibn Ajlan carry Ibn Abbas before Ali, so it gives the true shape of those two routes of this saying, not another version.
reasons.quote: - إلا الضحاك وابن عجلان فإنهما زادا عن ابن عباس، عن علي، -

reasons.claim: Al-Dahhak heads the third branch, so its route runs through Ibn Abbas.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، حدثنا الضحاك بن عثمان

reasons.claim: Ibn Ajlan heads the fourth branch, so its route also runs through Ibn Abbas; the gloss on Yahya is left out.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى، - وهو القطان - عن ابن عجلان

reasons.claim: The three co-transmitters of the sixth branch share Ismail and Muhammad, and the glosses on both are not links.
reasons.quote: قالوا حدثنا إسماعيل، - يعنون ابن جعفر - أخبرني محمد، وهو ابن عمرو

reasons.claim: The closing list names those whose versions mention prostration, a remark about other versions, not a route.
reasons.quote: كما ذكر الزهري وزيد بن أسلم والوليد بن كثير وداود بن قيس

notes: «إلا الضحاك وابن عجلان فإنهما زادا عن ابن عباس، عن علي» states the routes of the al-Dahhak and Ibn Ajlan branches: Ibn Abbas stands between «أبيه» and Ali in those two routes only, so each tail is written out and shared_tail is null.
«كما ذكر الزهري وزيد بن أسلم والوليد بن كثير وداود بن قيس» is a remark about other versions: a variant group.

reviews.uncertainty_note: Both readers read the Ibn Abbas clause as a remark; I read it as stating the route of two branches, which the wording «زادا» inside the isnad supports but a second review should confirm.

reasons.claim: Yahya read to Malik, who transmits from Abd Allah b. Dinar from Ibn Umar, the last link.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: The closing sentence is Abd Allah b. Dinar's comment inside the same chain with no isnad of its own, so it adds no route.
reasons.quote: قال عبد الله بن دينار كان ابن عمر يفعل ذلك

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Abd Allah and is said not to be raised, so it ends at him as written.
reasons.quote: عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن عبد الله، نحوه ولم يرفعه

reasons.claim: The compiler's comparison with Anbasa's report names another version and is a remark, not a route.
reasons.quote: وهذا أصح من حديث عنبسة عن أبي حمزة

reasons.claim: The note on Abu Hamza is a gloss and adds no link.
reasons.quote: وأبو حمزة هو ميمون الأعور

reasons.claim: The stored chain's second branch ends in words of the matn, not a name.
reasons.quote: النعى أذان بالميت
